I'm an Android and Kotlin Multiplatform engineer with 7 years of experience. At **[Rive](https://rive.app)**, I maintain the [open-source Android runtime](https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android) and help companies integrate Rive into their Android apps. As part of the DevRel team, I also write samples and docs for Android developers.

## In the community

- **Organizer** of GDG Korea Android and other developer groups
- **Speaker** at [KotlinConf 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nziQi2Mg1OY), WOOWACON, DroidKnights, and more ([all talks](https://speakerdeck.com/wisemuji))
- **Maintainer** of open-source Kotlin libraries such as [Jindong](https://github.com/compose-jindong/jindong), a Kotlin Multiplatform haptics library
- **Author** of 20+ Android and Kotlin [articles](https://medium.com/@wisemuji) with 50K+ views, some featured in Kotlin Weekly and Android Weekly

Over the years, I've **organized 30+ developer events for 7,000+ attendees**. I enjoy sharing what I learn and talking with other developers, so I'm always happy to chat about Android, Kotlin Multiplatform, or Rive!
